dedupe_resolutions.notes: Vance's end-times statement was made in a broad faith interview and did not explicitly concern Iran or any particular official act. It remains a distinct governance and risk-framing statement rather than being merged into the Iran/Hormuz war record.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

The shared White House fact sheet reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One record concerns announced company agreements; the other concerns an administration-reported program measurement.

The August employment release is an independently measured economic outcome. Trump's subsequent trade threat used the report as context but is a distinct presidential risk statement with no implementing instrument; neither record substitutes for the other.

The September 4 orders direct ranching, competition, processing, wolf and labeling actions. The August 26 proclamation separately implemented a temporary lean-beef import quota increase; the instruments and outcome tests are distinct.

The national measles surveillance outcome concerns a vaccine-preventable infectious disease. The August 31 newborn record measures vitamin K nonreceipt, which is not a vaccine and involves a different intervention, population and outcome.

LEG-004706 records the June 22 district-court summary judgment vacating modified SAVE. The new record covers the September 4 appellate refusal to stay that judgment and the expedited merits appeal; both stages remain cross-referenced under the same litigation.

The Central African Republic record covers a second implemented flight to that country. The Guyana record covers the first implemented group under a separate bilateral arrangement, different people and different post-transfer terms.

The Liberia record documents a separate agreement and capacity announcement. The Guyana record documents actual arrival of a different six-person group under a one-year temporary arrangement; neither is a duplicate of the other.

rejected_candidates.title: Trump Truth Social Iran economy, oil and Hormuz graphics
rejected_candidates.reason: Several September 6 posts asserted that Iran's currency, oil exports and economy were collapsing and that Hormuz traffic was nearly restored. The posts prove only that Trump published those claims. Independently reported economic and fuel-policy evidence was incorporated into the existing Iran/Hormuz record with explicit causal and outcome limits; the raw graphics were not treated as proof.

rejected_candidates.title: Trump Truth Social White House helipad completion claim
rejected_candidates.reason: Trump said at 1:57:42 PM EDT that a White House helipad had just been completed. Earlier reporting documented a privately funded plan and construction, but no new official completion record, final cost, authority file or independent completion report was located by cutoff, so the claim remains in the raw feed.

rejected_candidates.title: White House ballroom construction post
rejected_candidates.reason: Trump posted an image of unfinished ballroom and military-complex construction at 3:06:45 PM EDT. The project and its pending litigation are already recorded, and the image established no new court ruling, contract, appropriation, completion or independently measured consequence.

rejected_candidates.title: Trump Intel government-stock profit claim
rejected_candidates.reason: Trump asserted at 3:17:16 PM EDT that federal stock holdings had made hundreds of billions of dollars and highlighted Intel's share-price rise. The Intel stake dates to 2025; the post identified no new purchase, sale or realized Treasury receipt, and no independent current valuation supporting the aggregate claim was located by cutoff.

rejected_candidates.title: Truth Social jobs, trade, Space Force and political graphics
rejected_candidates.reason: The remaining policy-themed posts repeated the already recorded August jobs estimate, generic allegations of foreign trade barriers, Space Force imagery, foreign-election graphics and political advocacy without a new implementing instrument or independently verified lifecycle change.

rejected_candidates.title: Truth Social memes, historical images, insults and self-promotion
rejected_candidates.reason: Image-only maps, synthetic or symbolic scenes, personal praise, insults and campaign-style material made up most of the 37 new posts. They disclosed no material federal action and remain only in the separate raw-post feed.

rejected_candidates.title: Ukraine, mail-ballot and other follow-up coverage
rejected_candidates.reason: New coverage did not change the completed-meeting and pending-litigation states already recorded at the prior cutoff. No new ceasefire, Supreme Court order or other independently verified lifecycle change occurred in this window.

rejected_candidates.title: External archive discovery leads
rejected_candidates.reason: All four registered archives were rechecked at their primary project pages or official public endpoints. Measurements remain in their separate upstream units, and no external item advanced without original-source inspection and full Record review.
